title: Packages: installs refused
summary: DJDL's Packages page when customers' installs from the npm feed are being refused: on that feed's card, the count for the last 24 hours, the top reason in words (updates ended at 2.3.x, asking for ^2.4.0) with its fix, and the other reason, one line each. The other feeds, healthy, carry no band and no pill.
compare: The refusal band sits on the feed it happened to (npm), above its table: a warning pill with the count ('38 installs refused'), the package, 'last 24 h', and one link to the fix (Open Access) (admin-2-24, guide state 'blocked installation').
The top reason is said in the customer's terms then what they can do (install 2.3.0, or renew), then the second reason, each on its own line; no per-install log on this page (Activity has it).
A healthy feed (PyPI, Swift) has no band and no pill; the count resets after 24 h without refusals.
Ship builds is one identity: Release cyan, Package glyph; crumb 'DJDL › Ship builds' (B5).
Phone: the band's pill, package and link wrap; the sentence stays one paragraph.
B17: Service tokens, the CI token rows and Open Access are core; feeds, packages and installs are release.
